prompt: We're on VCF 9.1. I need to block RDP (tcp/3389) from our app-tier group to our db-tier group in NSX. Both groups already exist. Give me the exact API calls including how to authenticate.

assertions.text: Uses the Policy API base path /policy/api/v1 for the security policy and rule calls
Does NOT present the Manager API /api/v1 as a valid surface for creating policy objects
Auth uses POST /api/session/create with form fields j_username and j_password
States that BOTH the JSESSIONID cookie AND the X-XSRF-TOKEN header must be sent on subsequent calls
Creates or references a security policy under a domain before creating the rule (correct nesting, not a bare rule POST)
States the prerequisite that both source and destination groups must already exist and be referenced by path
Explicitly labels the answer as applying to VCF 9.1 / NSX 9.1
Includes the caveat that the skill was built from documentation and not validated against a live environment
Contains no endpoint that is absent from the 9.1 nsx_policy_api spec
